Using Behavioral Assessments in Talent Acquisition
Dr. Fred Rafilson has identified 3 key characteristics to look for in Behavioral Assessments: Validity – Reliability – Fairness. Listen to the HR Mavericks podcast to hear Dr. Fred’s insights.
Read More

The skill of an interviewer could mean the difference between hiring a good quality candidate and not identifying any candidates at all. The lack of ability to quality control interviews can lead to an increased risk of bad hires and the loss of qualified candidates.

Talview Interview Insights uses advanced AI capabilities to coach interviewers, one interview at a time. The award-winning Solution brings specific, explainable, and actionable insights into interviewing for organizations of all sizes.

LinkedIn
found that between 2013 and 2018, the number of HR professionals listing data skills on their profiles increased threefold.

Dr. Fred Rafilson, Chief I/O Psychologist, highlights how TA professionals can educate candidates about the use of AI in the hiring process.
